raw:
@q query
  select ?c1
  select ?c2
  where all
    match
      relation "cost for a month of commuting"
      role subject "the Luas monthly ticket"
      role object ?c1
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "cost for a month of commuting"
      role subject "letting the Leap card cap kick in"
      role object ?c2
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
